Power Dot France.rule: Only connector tariffs returned by the official Power Dot public ad-hoc API are overlaid; all unmatched or failed rows remain fail-closed.

WAAT.rule: Use only rows whose exact EVSE ID starts FR*WA2* and the tariff fields returned by Monta's public CPO pricing dataset. Never apply a site, operator or national fallback; every PAN EVSE absent from the public export remains fail-closed/unpriced.

Bouygues Energies & Services.rule: Use only exact PDC tariffs returned for PAN-matched Alize public-map locations. Do not infer a Bouygues-wide or sub-network-wide tariff. Any unmatched PDC, marker/detail error, or matched PDC without a returned price remains fail-closed/unpriced.

IZIVIA.source: IZIVIA public map / national physical pricing snapshot
IZIVIA.rule: Use only tariff text returned for the exact matched IZIVIA public-map station/location. Never substitute a national, network or power-band tariff when an exact station tariff is absent; every unmatched or unpriced PAN station/PDC remains fail-closed.

TotalEnergies Marketing France.rule: Apply the official station-service tariff only to EVSE proven to be TotalEnergies station-service chargers and classify by the EVSE's documented power. Do not apply it to TotalEnergies-operated local concessions, roadside networks, partner networks or Charge+ roaming rows; those remain fail-closed unless their own exact tariff is proven.

TotalEnergies Charging Services.source: official sub-network tariff publications including ilewatt and TotalEnergies Charge+ City Aix-Marseille-Provence
TotalEnergies Charging Services.rule: Apply a tariff only when the PAN row can be positively tied to the exact published TotalEnergies-operated sub-network and its power/time conditions. Never extend an Ilewatt, Aix-Marseille, station-service or other local tariff to generic TotalEnergies Charging Services rows. Every unclassified sub-network, unmatched EVSE, or tariff component not machine-validated remains fail-closed.

Allego.source: Allego official Pricing page + Find Us map / Allego app Price Details
Allego.rule: Never apply Allego's country headline tariffs as a universal station fallback. Use only the current rate and any time/occupancy fees shown for the exact charger on Allego's official Find Us map/app Price Details surface; unmatched or unqueried EVSE remain fail-closed.

GROUPE INDIGO.rule: Use the official public tariff only for INDIGO Recharge parking EVSE proven to be within its published scope. Apply the published 0.30 EUR/kWh + 0.03 EUR/min exception only to the four explicitly named cities. Any non-classifiable station or separately operated fast-charging partner remains fail-closed.

Tesla.pricingModel: site-specific time bands with separate Tesla-owner and other-EV rates
Tesla.rule: Use only the current tariff bands displayed on the exact official Tesla Find Us Supercharger page. Preserve time bands and Tesla-owner versus other-EV pricing. Never infer a national tariff or copy a nearby site's price; unresolved sites remain fail-closed.

Lidl France.rule: Apply 0.29 EUR/kWh only to Lidl direct AC points and 0.39 EUR/kWh only to Lidl direct DC points whose operator/scope and type are established. Third-party mobility-card commissions are outside the Lidl direct tariff and must not be inferred. Unclassifiable rows remain fail-closed.

Electra.source: Electra official app / station charger pre-session price
Electra.pricingModel: station/time/demand dynamic; exact rate displayed before session and locked for session
Electra.rule: Never apply the 0.39-0.61 EUR/kWh range or any headline rate as a station fallback. Use only the current exact tariff displayed for the exact station in Electra's official app or on the charger before plugging in, preserving time bands. Any station/EVSE without a deterministic exact-price capture remains fail-closed.

E-Totem.source: official E-Totem network/app surfaces + existing operator-direct datasets
E-Totem.rule: Apply only an exact published tariff for the exact e-Totem-operated network/station/offer. Do not extrapolate SEMOB rates to FR*ETI or roaming networks; unresolved stations/EVSE remain fail-closed.

Bump.source: Bump official app/help exact station tariff surface
Bump.pricingModel: site-specific; Bump-operated prices set by site manager
Bump.rule: Use only the exact tariff displayed for the exact Bump station/EVSE. Partner-network prices, minimum-charge examples, power bands, and nearby-site prices are never used as fallbacks; unresolved rows remain fail-closed.

EVzen.source: EVzen official map/app/QR plus official operated-network tariff pages
EVzen.rule: Never use the 0.39-0.55 EUR/kWh range as a fallback. Use only the exact direct EVzen station tariff from app/screen/QR or a published network-specific tariff when the PAN row is positively tied to that exact managed network and conditions. Unmatched rows remain fail-closed.

STATIONS-E.rule: Apply only to EVSE positively identified as direct STATIONS-E points and classified as 22AC, 24DC or 50DC. Partner stations use partner-defined prices and must never inherit STATIONS-E direct rates. Unknown or ambiguous EVSE remain fail-closed.

LIDL France.rule: Same official Lidl France direct tariff applies only to rows positively identified as Lidl-operated direct charging points; classify AC versus DC from documented connector type. Mobility-card surcharges and ambiguous rows remain fail-closed.

TESLA France SARL.pricingModel: site-specific time bands; exact Find Us/app tariff only
TESLA France SARL.rule: Treat the legal-entity PAN label as Tesla direct only where the EVSE/site is positively matched to an official Tesla Supercharger location. Use only that exact site's current Find Us/app price bands; never inherit a national or nearby Tesla price. Unmatched rows remain fail-closed.

Interparking France.rule: Apply only to EVSE positively identified as Interparking France direct charging points in the published scope. Third-party mobility-card surcharges are external and must not be inferred; ambiguous or separately operated rows remain fail-closed.

Virta.pricingModel: charge-point specific; operator-controlled exact price displayed before charging
Virta.rule: Never infer a Virta-wide tariff. Use only tariff components shown for the exact charger ID on Virta's official one-time-payment website or mobile app. Preserve energy, time, session and alternate-period components; Connected-to-Virta and roaming points may differ. Unmatched EVSE remain fail-closed.

method: A CPO is counted treated only when an exact non-extrapolated tariff source has been made usable for at least a validated subset and all unresolved rows are explicitly fail-closed. A CPO is set aside only after official site/map, web bundles/APIs, public or guest endpoints/open data/EVSE IDs, useful third-party station services, and available mobile-app surfaces have been explored without obtaining a usable exact tariff source.
